notes.title: 6-1-22 update and Absinthia Kickstarter Launch
notes.content:
Hello! A small update released today:

[list]
[*] Added Twitter and Discord buttons to the start menu as well as an image and link to the Absinthia Kickstarter
[*] Added a wolf statue to the Hart City Statue room to offer a link to [i]Absinthia's [/i]Kickstarter page
[/list]

if you encounter any problems with this update, feel free to contact me here or via email at Jkweath (@) gmail.com.

[h1]The Absinthia Kickstarter[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41960886/26ebbd896333ab8579ca8346b593b8039aa40538.png[/img]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/jkweath/absinthia][b]The [i]Absinthia [/i]Kickstarter is LIVE! Here's the link![/b][/url]

And here's a quick overview of the reward tiers:

[b]Tier 1:[/b] Digital Key
[b]Tier 2:[/b] OST + Desktop Wallpapers
[b]Tier 3:[/b] Digital copies of [i]Celestial Hearts[/i] and [i]Knight Bewitched[/i]
[b]Tier 4:[/b] Absinthia Early Access (~1-2 months in advance)

The following tiers also include tiers 1-4 and a unique [url=discord.gg/cE2fCQAjC6]Discord[/url] server role:

[b]Tier 5:[/b] Leave a message! (on a poster, grave, or book)
[b]Tier 6:[/b] Design a legendary weapon! (5 slots)
[b]Tier 7:[/b] Become an NPC! (40 slots)
[b]Tier 8:[/b] Design an enemy! (10 slots)
[b]Tier 9:[/b] Design a boss! (5 slots)
[b]Tier 10:[/b] Design a quest & NPC! (3 slots)
[strike][b]Tier 11:[/b] Become a dungeon master![/strike] Sold out!

[h3]FAQ[/h3]

[b]Will there be digital keys offered for other platforms (namely the Nintendo Switch)?[/b]

I'm working with my publisher to see if I can offer Switch keys, but in all likelihood I won't have a definitive answer until [i]Absinthia [/i]is finished. Unfortunately, the answer at this time is "I don't know". My publisher is handling the console porting and publishing, so whether or not I can obtain console keys is entirely up to them.

[b]Are there be any physical rewards?[/b]

Nope, not this time! For context, the physical rewards offered with the Knight Bewitched campaign were a total wash (I actually [i]lost[/i] money from them, and they were a [i]huge [/i]time sink!)

[b]Is [i]Absinthia [/i]a sequel?[/b]

[i]Absinthia[/i] takes place some time after the events and features some characters from my previous game [i]Celestial Hearts[/i]. That said, [i]Absinthia[/i]'s story was written to stand alone, so you don't need to play [i]Knight Bewitched[/i] or [i]Celestial Hearts[/i] first to enjoy the story.

[b]Is this game SFW?[/b]

Yes. The story features sapphic/yuri elements, but there is no nudity/NSFW content.

If you have any further questions, feel free to comment here or on the Kickstarter page itself! Once again, [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/jkweath/absinthia]here is a link to the Kickstarter[/url][/b]. See you there, and have a great week!

notes.title: Celestial Hearts News and Absinthia Kickstarter + Demo
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I made a couple similar announcements to this one on my other titles [i]Knight Bewitched[/i] and [i]Knight Eternal [/i], so I figured I'd make another one!

(And if you're seeing this for the 3rd time and thinking, "Why does this look familiar?" sorry!)

I wanted to take an opportunity to share a few fun tidbits about [i]Celestial Hearts[/i] followed by some news for my upcoming title [i]Absinthia[/i].

Originally released on February 15, 2021, [i]Celestial Hearts[/i] was my 6th official release (technically my 7th overall, but I'm not counting [i]Roguelite[/i]). It was my first title to be built in (what was new at the time) the RPG Maker MZ engine, and also my 2nd title to feature a side-view battle system.

To date, [i]Celestial Hearts [/i]has sold about 1,200 copies on Steam. With Steam key activations, that number goes up to almost 1,350. Counting sales from other sites like Itch, Aldorlea and Google Play, total copies distributed is likely close to 1,600.

[h2]Absinthia[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32517448/feb65f58ec9a77577797557194974ca15028aed4.png[/img]

With that out of the way, let's talk about my upcoming title [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1848070/Absinthia/][i]Absinthia[/i][/url]! Make sure to stop by the Steam page and add it to your wishlist! (No, seriously, please! Wishlists are super important for the algorithm!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32517448/19eaf25fcfa6e91ebde7f53e8aecc6b32cff0f7c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32517448/b07fc0cda7d5117b9a2ebf4450f67116f66cf57c.png[/img]

A demo for Absinthia is available and can be downloaded from the game's store page!

[b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/jkweath/absinthia]A crowdfunding campaign for Absinthia[/url] [/b]will launch in mid-late April and run through May. If successful, we're looking at a release date of January 2023. 

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/jkweath/absinthia][b]You can click here to be notified when the campaign goes live![/b][/url]

Similar to my campaigns for [i]Celestial Hearts[/i] and [i]Knight Bewitched: Enhanced Edition[/i], we're crowdfunding to cover the cost of assets. The artwork is being done by various talented pixel artists, while Jazz Stewart is making a return from [i]Knight Bewitched: Enhanced Edition[/i] for the original soundtrack.

We're looking to raise about $23,000. This is significantly more than our previous campaigns - but with a higher funding goal comes better rewards, such as:

-Digital keys, OST, desktop wallpapers and credits
-Digital keys for Knight Bewitched and Celestial Hearts
-Early Access
-Leaving your own message in an object in-game
-Having your own NPC complete with name and dialogue
-Designing your own legendary weapon, enemy, boss, or your own quest!

If you have any questions about [i]Absinthia[/i], feel free to ask here or DM me on [url=https://twitter.com/Jkweath]Twitter[/url].

Have a great week and stay safe!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32517448/2d1c0648587714411ddbcee05e1024a9969dc8a5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32517448/ed2b37ff10d0281fa8020d3f8f294269d5cabad3.png[/img]

notes.title: 3-4-2021 Patch
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Animations should play more smoothly and cause significantly less lag on lower-end PCs
[*] A minor change was made to how achievements are activated to attempt to combat a crashing bug (explained below)
[/list]

I'm currently investigating a bug that can cause the game to hard-crash when attempting to activate an achievement. This only seems to occur when Celestial Hearts has difficulty communicating with Steam (either Steam isn't loaded and connected or the player didn't buy the game through Steam)

I'm not 100% sure this update will solve the problem, but I'm still looking into it and will hopefully have a solution soon! If this problem happens to you, or achievements aren't activating, you can email me anytime at Jkweath@gmail.com or leave a comment here.

notes.title: 3-2-2021 News
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The launch of Celestial Hearts exceeded my expectations, having even outperformed the launches of my previous two best sellers [i]Knight Bewitched 1 and 2.[/i] So far I've only needed to release two minor bugfix patches!

I mentioned this in my previous patch update, but if you're reading this and you've finished (or are close to finishing) [i]Celestial Hearts[/i], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1434350/Celestial_Hearts/]I'd greatly appreciate it if you could leave a review[/url]. Reviews, especially from those who bought the game directly from Steam, are crucial to the continued sales of any indie game including Celestial Hearts. As of this update, I need [b]6[/b] more reviews to get an official Steam rating.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39008709/5a07f956d03e620dfbc386fbb9b5cf29d082b1f0.png[/img]

[h2]Celestial Hearts for Android[/h2]

The good news is that I'm working on porting Celestial Hearts to the Google Play Store. The bad news is that the engine Celestial Hearts wasn't designed with mobile performance in mind. I'm working on finding ways to improve the UI and performance, but most likely the Android port will only be available for download on high-end modern devices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39008709/662bf81c0a82747cb4b37a9d560d2a150953e953.png[/img]
(yeah...still trying to figure this out)

[h2]My next project[/h2]

I've mentioned this previously as well, but I'm currently working on an Enhanced Edition of my bestseller [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/815150/Knight_Bewitched/]Knight Bewitched.[/url] I'll be making an "official" announcement in a week or two to document all the changes as well as the Kickstarter campaign I'll be launching to fund the art illustrations and original soundtrack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39008709/22264fc700f6885ff1cdb9a652ed5e5369656ca9.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39008709/811752e558a74b8078fd2e8c6d56cc20d3b633c5.png[/img]

That's all for now. Until next time!

notes.title: Celestial Hearts release date and my next project
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39008709/866a4302148c69e1739b92c7452aef5217008628.png[/img]

Hello again!

The new battle sprites were finished ahead of schedule, so I went ahead and began distributing pre-release keys to Kickstarter backers and Steam curators.

I'm keeping the release date at February 15 to give me time to implement feedback and to give content creators time before the game's release.

[h3]My next project[/h3]

I generally don't announce projects before they're at least 25% finished, but my next likely project is a complete remastered edition of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/815150/Knight_Bewitched/][i]Knight Bewitched.[/i][/url]

Knight Bewitched was my second title (for context, Celestial Hearts is my 8th). I've debated with myself whether I should re-do Knight Bewitched for awhile now, and came to the conclusion that I should after realizing that I don't feel comfortable recommending content creators play it in its current state.

I don't have any details to reveal about the remaster itself, but the goal is to keep the story mostly the same while changing and adding enough new content to warrant a 2nd play for old fans and make the game even more attractive to potential new fans.

That's all I have for now. Have a great week and stay safe!

notes.title: Celestial Hearts is 100% funded! Now let's talk stretch goals...
notes.content:
Hello again![url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/jkweath/celestial-hearts][b] As of today, we've hit 100% of the campaign goal for Celestial Hearts[/b][/url]! I never imagined we'd hit it this fast. I greatly appreciate everyone who's helped us come this far!
For this update, I want to talk about the three stretch goals I lined out on the main Kickstarter page, and also to clarify a couple other details on the "Become a Statue" backer tiers:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39008709/4f09fbf508e34fdbd646226a535249f37271e72a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39008709/4980f4b9731fbe4b3a1b214b5292265645a72074.png[/img]

Those who back at the $20 tier and up will have a statue for themselves placed in this room. The character on the statue will be randomly generated (though I can take small requests for how the character should look). Backers will be asked the following questions:

-What name to leave on the statue (if I don't receive a reply, I'll go with your Kickstarter name. Full names will have their last name abbreviated)
-Whether you'd like to show your contribution ('no' by default)
-A short message you'd like to leave

If requested, I can also place a small weapon in front of the statue - I mostly have sword variations, but I also have an axe, daggers, scepter and bow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39008709/0867dce10820344c8fd49258165e8b2bd5e693f4.png[/img]

[h2]$1300 Stretch goal: Vagrant's Arena[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39008709/fec040665e00ea877ad4f64740199bfac7e67608.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39008709/23ed8c7ba9a87016e2a7c0486731cd89b8f5ed81.png[/img]

Vagrant's Arena is a place for adventurers from all around the world to come and prove their worth in combat. After facing four waves of enemies without rest--and no items--you'll then face off against another group of adventurers much like yourselves!

Vagrant himself is the grandson of a certain young dragon knight you might be familiar with--and if you're lucky, he won't be the only descendant-of-a-famous-hero you run into here.

[h2]$1500 Stretch goal: The Depths[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39008709/b955279fdd187eae76561a31af8b481560ee133a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39008709/5e1c8c5e1466314797c251113353aaf50bb8a7d7.png[/img]

Featured in two of my previous titles, [i]Knight Bewitched[/i] and [i]Finding Light[/i], The Depths is a massive challenge dungeon comprised of four smaller dungeons and a, erm... Rather odd town stuck in the middle.

While the layout of The Depths is the same as in the previous titles, the environments are all slightly different--as well as the loot, enemies and bosses. Both Vagrant's Arena and The Depths have elements that tie into the storyline as well.

[b]$2000 Stretch goal: New hero battle sprites[/b]

So I gotta be honest here: I hadn't planned on hitting the crowdfunding goal this soon. I figured it'd be a last-minute thing where some generous donor would cover the last bit of funding needed just hours before the campaign ended - let alone hitting the goal over a week beforehand!

The $2000 stretch goal outlined in the Kickstarter is aimed toward replacing the "stock" hero sprites during battle scenes with new, higher-quality sprites. Unfortunately, I don't have an example image to show what a new set of sprites would look like. I'll be on the lookout for an artist who can do this work--and if the campaign looks like it might hit the $2000 stretch goal before the 26th, I'll release another update promoting it and going for one big final push!

Thanks again to all of you! If you have any questions, feel free to ask (I've probably missed something!). We still have 9 days to go!

Have a great week and stay safe!

notes.title: Kickstarter and Progress Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We're not far into the campaign and we've already passed the 50% mark! That's great news, and I'm really happy that people are as excited for Celestial Hearts as I am. There's 16 days left, and we still have a long way to go!

All 25 of the $7 Early Backer Rewards have been taken, but (at the time of this update) there are still some Early Backer Pre-Release rewards left. For just $3 more, you can have Celestial Hearts two weeks in advance!

Anyway, I wanted to share that I've added a new $50 backer tier:

[h3]Design a weapon![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39008709/5c7a0dafc1d223852fa0615205d3d62f5efc93b7.gif[/img]

Unlike my previous releases (like Knight Bewitched), Celestial Hearts uses a side-view battle system. Thanks to that, you can actually see the weapons each party member is equipped with--and if you're interested, you can design your own!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39008709/109815a3a9838e2ca9d3fe4b82de36c30c2ddfb6.png[/img]

Of course, if you're not an artist, you can simply describe how you want the weapon to look, and I can either pull from a selection of weapons on-hand or commission an artist myself.

Here's the details for this new backer tier:

[list]
[*] The size of the weapon can be up to 48 x 48 pixels. (you could make the weapon smaller, but then you wouldn't be able to see it!)
[*]You can provide a name (up to 20 characters) and, optionally, a short description around 20 words / 120 characters.
[*]I will determine the stats of the weapon, but you can specify which stats or elemental affinities you'd rather the weapon be geared toward (is this a "hit-things-first, ask-questions-later kind of weapon? Maybe it's more defensive? Or a lightning-fast dagger, perhaps?)
[/list]

Here are the weapon types you can choose from, and which character they'll belong to:
[list]
[*]Kayah: hunting horns / horn-like weapons
[*]Helen: swords, maces / hammers, spears
[*]Sylvie: bows, crossbows
[*]Gail: knives, ringblades / fist weapons, scythes / khopesh
[*]Matthias: staves / staff-like weapons
[/list]

Of course, you're welcome to be creative (to an extent - let's stay appropriate, please). Want Kayah to wield a giant fish-horn? Go for it! A bow that shoots other bows? Fine by me! 

This $50 backer tier has 6 spots available and includes all other rewards below it. If you've already backed the project, you're free to upgrade to this tier anytime.

[h2]Game Progress[/h2]

Long story short - it's coming along smoothly!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39008709/5b6e6a6ed796816fb394f5c53ce90777e723b2e9.png[/img]

I don't have a whole lot to show off right now, but the project has reached its second-to-final stage of development: Writing! Just about everything else is finished, and all that's left to do is actually write the dialogue, design the cutscenes, and then begin the long process of playtesting!

Based on my current rate of progress, I'm thinking Celestial Hearts will be finished by late December and will release in late January/early February. This means that those subscribed to the Early Backer pre-release tier will receive their Steam copies around mid-January.

That's all for now! If you have any questions or comments about Celestial Hearts, the new backer tier (or any other tier), or just want to say something, you can leave a comment here or email me at Jkweath@gmail.com.
